term: richness of the domain of facts
definition: UnexplainedFacts A w says that for each unexplained contingent truth f at w the domain has a fact true exactly where f is true and unexplained, with f as a conjunct. Extensional A says every set of worlds is the extension of a fact. EntailmentConjunct A says being a conjunct coincides with being entailed at every world.
